jobs.occupation: Customer Support Advisor: English + German + 1 other European Language - Multiple Shifts - Oostakker
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.
 

 
• Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns. 
 
• Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved. 
 
• Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance. 
 
• Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure. 
 
• Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support. 
 
• Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences. 

- You speak and write fluently in English, German and at least one other European language. 

 
• Service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations. 
 
• Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts. 
 
• You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed. 
 
• Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends. 
 
• A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset. 
 
• Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

Responsibilities

• Collaborate with business stakeholders to document requirements, objectives, and complex processes.
• Translate business needs into detailed functional specifications and user stories for IT applications.
• Partner with development teams to ensure technical solutions align with business objectives and architectural standards.
• Support the quality assurance lifecycle by developing test plans and coordinating user acceptance testing.
• Identify and resolve functional defects while providing continuous guidance to project teams.
• Document API specifications and provide feasibility studies for new digital services.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in business and functional analysis within Agile or SAFe environments.
• 5+ years of experience with business process modelling using BPMN or UML.
• 5+ years of experience writing User Stories and managing SDLC methodologies.
• 2+ years of experience performing functional analysis within a Sitecore CMS environment.
• You possess professional experience in the public transport or e-commerce sectors.
• You bring technical knowledge of international rail travel systems, including PNR, content distribution, and seat reservations.
• You have experience with API documentation and feasibility study execution.
• You're detail-oriented with strong analytical skills and a proactive approach to troubleshooting.
• You are fluent in English with a C1 level in Dutch or French.
Nice to Haves

• Experience with multi-channel digital sales platforms.
• Willingness to obtain certifications in advanced analysis methodologies.

jobs.occupation: Modern Workplace System Engineer – Microsoft 365 & Intune
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Manage and support the Microsoft 365 modern workplace environment, focusing on endpoint management and identity services.
• Configure and maintain Microsoft Intune policies, including device compliance, configuration profiles, and application deployment.
• Administer identities, users, and access within Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory.
• Support endpoint provisioning and lifecycle management using Windows Autopilot and Windows 11.
• Automate administrative activities and operational tasks using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API.
• Provide Level 2 and Level 3 technical support for complex incidents related to workplace technologies.

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience as a System Administrator in the setup and maintenance of enterprise systems.
• 3+ years of hands-on experience in the administration and support of Microsoft 365 environments.
• You possess proven experience in Microsoft Modern Workplace and endpoint management for Windows devices.
• You bring hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, including device management, configuration profiles, and application deployment.
• You have experience with Mobile Device Management (MDM) tools for iOS devices.
• You're knowledgeable in Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory, covering user, group, and identity administration.
• You possess AZ-900, AZ-104, and MS-102 certifications.
• You are fluent in English with fluency in either French or Dutch.
Nice to Haves

• Experience managing Exchange Online and hybrid cloud/on-premise environments.
• Knowledge of Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Conditional Access, and identity security controls.
• Familiarity with ITIL processes, specifically Change Management.
• Proficiency in automation using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph API.

jobs.occupation: IT Project Manager – Software Development & Agile Delivery
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Plan and organize complex IT software development and implementation projects from inception to completion.
• Monitor project scope, timing, budget, capacity, and risks to ensure successful delivery.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary teams and external vendors within a multi-project delivery context.
• Facilitate release management, implementations, and migrations while ensuring rigorous quality control.

• You have a Master's degree or equivalent through relevant professional experience.

• You possess expertise in project management methodologies such as Prince2 or PMBok.
• You have extensive experience with agile frameworks, specifically Scrum and Kanban.
• You bring proficiency in project and backlog management tools like Jira or Azure DevOps.

• You're able to translate business needs into technical solutions while managing budget and capacity.

• Knowledge of ITIL principles and service management processes.
• Proficiency in MS Project and MS Office.
• Experience with Enterprise Architecture alignment and data migrations.
• Involvement in RFI, RFP, or vendor selection trajectories.
• Experience with demand management and financial forecasting.
